style: Create ONE finished landscape 16:9 Facebook promotional illustration for Sparkle Valley, part of a coherent set of seven. Use the PROVIDED REFERENCE IMAGE as the strict visual design reference: bright cheerful storybook cartoon valley with layered low-poly-like illustrated trees, turquoise waterways, flower borders, cream organic rounded panels, chunky dark-purple outlines, playful pink/purple white-outlined Sparkle Valley wordmark, original purple/gold owl. Preserve its very specific illustrated game-brand world and flat outlined storybook people. NOT screenshots, NOT devices containing screenshots, NOT photographic, NOT plush/Pixar/3D-rendered new characters. This is newly illustrated advertising art in the exact reference aesthetic, with generous large imagery (about 65%) and few clear text blocks (35%). All text crisp and readable. Render the Vietnamese diacritics carefully. Use the exact main title and the three given short labels; no dense paragraphs or unsupported added copy. Add the Sparkle Valley brand at top-left and a large green rounded footer button reading EXACTLY sparklevalley.au on EVERY image. Vietnam left, Australia right whenever both shown. Vietnamese cultural decor uses five-pointed đèn ông sao, not round red Chinese lanterns. Never mention ads, tracking, purchases, stores or guarantees.
cards: 01-learning
BÉ CHƠI VUI, HỌC ĐIỀU MỚI
Chữ cái & từ vựng | Đếm số & hình khối | Tiếng Việt & English

A delightful illustrated learning garden connecting Vietnam on the LEFT (Dragon Bridge, Hoan Kiem Turtle Tower) and Australia on the RIGHT (Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge). Foreground cream panels contain chunky outlined ABC tiles, a friendly fox vocabulary card, precisely three apples alongside the numeral 3, friendly circle/triangle/square shapes, and the original purple-and-gold owl. Ages label: Bé 2–8 tuổi. Small benefit line: Luyện tập từng chút qua trò chơi.
02-sounds-thinking
NGHE, NHỚ VÀ KHÁM PHÁ
Âm thanh & màu sắc | Âm nhạc & trí nhớ | Cùng bé luyện tập

Three large playful illustrated vignettes in a lush valley, never game screens: an adorable outlined cow with listening waves (animal sounds), four coloured paint pots and matching balloons (colours), colourful xylophone and paired fox/star memory cards (music and memory). Original purple-and-gold owl guides. Small benefit line: Lắng nghe, nhận biết màu và ghi nhớ.
03-folk-games
TUỔI THƠ BA MẸ, NIỀM VUI CỦA BÉ
Ô Ăn Quan | Kéo Co | Thả Diều

Three inviting illustrated folk-game scenes: a traditional Ô Ăn Quan board correctly drawn with TWO rows of FIVE small pits and one large semicircular pit at EACH end, stones inside; two flat outlined storybook children tugging a rope; a colourful diamond kite soaring over the river. Vietnamese landmarks, countryside and FIVE-POINTED Vietnamese star lanterns. Small benefit line: Tập đếm, tính lượt và phối hợp.
04-vietnamese-stories
CÙNG CON NGHE TRUYỆN VIỆT
Thánh Gióng | Cây khế | Sự tích dưa hấu

A big welcoming open illustrated storybook floating on a flowery valley reading meadow. Three beautiful clean vignettes in the book: Thánh Gióng beside a grey iron horse (gentle, no violence); a golden bird beside a starfruit tree; a whole green watermelon with one red slice. Flat outlined storybook characters, exactly like supplied reference, not glossy Pixar. Purple-and-gold owl reading beside book. Small benefit line: Nghe kể, làm quen từ và kể lại cùng ba mẹ.
05-festivals-rewards
KHÁM PHÁ, LÀM NHIỆM VỤ, NHẬN NIỀM VUI
Tết & Trung Thu | Phiêu lưu & nhiệm vụ gia đình | Hình dán & huy hiệu

A festive Vietnamese valley with Tết peach blossoms, square bánh chưng and FIVE-POINTED đèn ông sao lanterns for Trung Thu (never round Chinese lanterns). Illustrated winding dotted quest path leads to a cute treasure chest holding a sticker sheet, a star badge and a landmark postcard. Small illustrated inset of parent and child setting a dinner table together. Original purple-and-gold owl and flat outlined characters matching reference. Small qualification clearly readable: Phần thưởng theo hoạt động. Do not imply every festival has an exclusive badge.
06-parent-controls
BA MẸ CHỌN CÁCH CON CHƠI
Tuổi & độ khó | Ngôn ngữ & âm thanh | Nhắc nghỉ & lựa chọn trực tuyến

A warm illustrated Vietnamese parent beside child in a flower-filled storybook valley, flat rounded characters like the reference. Three large cream info panels display purple/gold original-styled icons: child/stepping-stones for age and difficulty; English/Tiếng Việt cards with speaker for language and audio; friendly clock and small globe for rest reminder and online choices. Do not draw real screenshots, phone UI, a lock or remote surveillance controls. Small benefit line: Điều chỉnh trải nghiệm phù hợp với gia đình.
07-parent-report
HIỂU THÊM GIỜ CHƠI CỦA CON
Thời gian chơi | Trò yêu thích | Những khám phá đã lưu

A kind Vietnamese parent and child discussing their adventures on a picnic blanket beside the original purple-and-gold owl. Large illustrated cream report page with seven simple colourful bars, three favourite-game picture icons, a postcard and star sticker. Make it an appealing conceptual illustration, NOT a screenshot or exact dashboard. Place a prominent label ON THE REPORT: Số liệu minh họa. Small factual line: Báo cáo riêng cho từng bé, lưu trên thiết bị. No IQ, skill percentage, test score, remote monitoring, cloud dashboard or guaranteed outcomes.
additionalScenes: CÙNG BÉ KHÁM PHÁ DANH LAM

A beautiful spacious scene-focused storybook panorama, NOT a feature infographic. Vietnam on LEFT with unmistakable yellow Da Nang DRAGON BRIDGE, Hoan Kiem lake and Turtle Tower, red The Huc Bridge, One Pillar Pagoda on its single column above lotus water. Australia on RIGHT with Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge. A winding river and dotted exploration path connect both. A small original purple-and-gold owl guides two flat outlined child explorers. Use just the short title, small subtitle and URL; let 85% of image be gorgeous game-world-inspired scenery. Gentle educational footer line optional: Cùng nhận biết địa danh và kể chuyện về quê hương. Depict these as an illustrated overview, not a geographically accurate map.
DẠO PHỐ, KHÁM PHÁ MÓN VIỆT
Cùng bé gọi tên những món quen thuộc

A delightful spacious Vietnamese street-food market illustration in the supplied Sparkle Valley brand style. Cozy yellow heritage houses with terracotta roofs, bright flower pots, leafy shade, small simple food stalls, a friendly phở noodle stand, bánh mì bread cart, and a tray of square bánh chưng. Flat outlined friendly vendors and a parent walking with child, purple-and-gold owl near a cute food menu. Show food carefully: phở is a white bowl with rice noodles, herbs and steam; bánh mì are crusty baguettes with greens; bánh chưng are green square leaf-wrapped parcels. Shops may have very short legible labels Phở / Bánh mì / Bánh chưng, no other signage gibberish or Chinese text. Use just a short title, small subtitle and URL, 85% beautiful scenery. No cooking simulator, recipes, purchases, nutrition guarantees or real food-delivery claims.
MỘT GÓC QUÊ HƯƠNG THÂN THƯƠNG
Khám phá hàng gánh cùng ba mẹ

A charming spacious Vietnamese village riverside illustration in the supplied Sparkle Valley brand style. Centrepiece: a smiling Vietnamese woman in simple áo bà ba and nón lá carrying a traditional wooden bamboo shoulder pole HÀNG GÁNH with TWO BALANCED WOVEN BASKETS suspended from the two ends, one basket holding a few ripe bananas and mangoes, the other flowers and vegetables. Not two separate hand-held shopping baskets; show the real shoulder-pole silhouette accurately. Friendly parent and child greet her beside heritage yellow houses and a small lotus pond; a tiny purple-and-gold owl observes. Soft countryside, a small footbridge, star lantern if any, flowers. 85% inviting art, minimal text: only headline, subtitle and sparklevalley.au. No new minigame claims or promise of actual purchases.

simpleScreen.title: BÉ DƯỚI 5 TUỔI? BẮT ĐẦU THẬT NHẸ NHÀNG
simpleScreen.scene: A spacious illustrated winding PATH OF BIG PICTURES through the cheerful valley, representing Sparkle Valley Simple screen for under-5s. Three or four large rounded illustrated stepping cards along the path show an animal/cow, a rainbow paint palette, a kite and a friendly storybook. A friendly preschool-aged flat outlined child points to one big picture while a parent sits nearby, with original purple-and-gold owl guiding. Illustrate the concept lovingly; NOT a screenshot, NOT a phone/tablet screen, NOT a giant smartphone mockup. The path of big pictures is the visual focus. Gentle cream title panel and three short labels. Small explanatory line: Ba mẹ có thể chọn theo tuổi của bé. No timers, test scores, crying, game-over, locks or claim of guaranteed learning. Keep enough scenery and original reference aesthetic.

corrections: Tết paper ornaments use flower motifs rather than Chinese-looking glyphs.
Favourite-games row uses matching memory cards rather than a story illustration.
All decorative lanterns in the food-stall illustration changed to five-pointed đèn ông sao.
note: Conceptual promotional illustrations, not game screenshots or a promise of pixel-identical UI. Existing supported activities and parent controls are described; illustrative statistics are explicitly labelled.
